_readme: Direct-sold sponsor placements. Edit this file only, then rebuild (python scripts/build.py).
slot: home | table | reports.  logo: path under site/ (e.g. brand/sponsors/acme.svg; put the file in site/brand/sponsors/).
url: https only; links get rel="sponsored noopener".  tagline: one short line (max 90 characters).
start/end: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Outside those dates the slot shows the 'Your company here' placeholder.
Entries are checked at build time and again in the reader's browser, so an expired banner disappears even between builds.
